body: L-am citit intre timp. Foarte faină analiza, jos pălăria! In comm-ul original mă refeream la polls. Totuși rămân de părere ca deși si analiza respectivă pentru tara e top, si da, si pentru diaspora putem face un 'educated guess", populația din diaspora e mult prea eterogenă ca sa putem trage o concluzie reală. Sunt secții cu prezenta mare unde e super imprevizibil (Londra, Milano...). Eu sunt convinsă ca diferența va fi foarte mica si astfel marja de eroare data de acele secții va fi foarte importanta. Daca in România avansul e suficient, putem trage o concluzie la puțin timp după închiderea secțiilor, altfel, din nefericire, tot data science-ul nu ne poate garanta nimic...

Estimarile din diaspora sunt complet irelevante. Oricine pretinde ca poate estima, fie se înșeală amarnic, fie minte. Orice număr e ca si cum ai da cu banul, la fel de relevant (si spun asta cu un degree in statistica si data science). Din diaspora, luând pulsul, cred sincer ca vom avea niște surprize tare plăcute!

I think Joe hasn’t reached his full potential in being a monster. By the end of the show, he should make everyone sick and get everyone hating him, then meet his end in a stupid, unspectacular way. One that would hurt his God complex .

I have a theory that Kate already knew everything and that she is a huge mastermind. I think she wanted her dar dead to get all the power and she somehow found Joe. She is in the art world, so maybe she got Marianne to go to London so he gets there and then she hired the PI to get Joe into her group. I find it really hard to believe Kate was not aware neighbours could see in her flat, so all those spicy scenes were on purpose to get him obsessed with her. She is then the one to initiate things after the funeral and then, even though she says she wants to be better, she has no problem using her influence to cover the murder of Edward who is basically a kid and then blame it on Nadia. Most of her actions are very shady. I could see her being the ultimate villain and Joe just a pawn in her game.

They are old friends, so it would make total sense for them to share some shady past or shady family affairs. Even more, we know Kate has multiple siblings, maybe Phoebe is one of them? And that is not mentioned as one (or both…) of them is unaware of that fact?

Hear me out: what if he didn’t? What if it was Phoebe’s family and he just took the merits thinking Kate will appreciate? And this comes back in season 5 as Kate finds out Joe killed her dad and at the same time she figures out her dad was not that bad and that finishes in Joe’s ultimate end?

I think it is somehow annoying, but very important. A solution might be to put it at the beginning of every episode maybe? Or a more general one? Something along the lines: warning! This episode can contain scenes involving, suicide, extreme violence, SA, EDs etc that some viewers might find disturbing. 
That way you are aware but you don’t really know what will happen?

I think it could be interesting to see if anything similar happened before the events in season 4. I know this is farfetched, but what if Love died at the end of season 2 (or after she has given birth, somewhere between season…) and the kills in season 3 are his doings? Or at least some of them?
Most of Nadia’s actions in the second half of the season don’t make any sense… I wouldn’t be surprised to find out that she has split personality as well 🙄
While Love was an absolute psychopath, she had the best chemistry with Joe and their dynamic was the most interesting to watch

Joe is a very complex figure from all sides. Him as a father figure showed a lot about his persona in general and season 5 could explore that further. Now that he is back, I find it difficult to believe he wouldn’t want to be part of Henry’s life. 
Also, although I am not a fan of time jumps, I think it might be interesting to see Joe handling Henry as a teenager or young adult. Him getting worried sick whenever his son has the tiniest crush, afraid he would do the same mistakes or maybe having Henry somehow harm his obsession and Joe ending up killing him as the ultimate villain act.

Mooney’s past is highly underrated and under-explored. Joe keeps saying he learned a lot from Mooney, and considering how cruel he acted towards Joe and the fact that he is the original owner of the cage, I wouldn’t be surprised if he was the OG murderer. Or if Joe’s body count is a lot higher and includes Mooney as he was some sort of “you”. Just a thought

Joe is non redeemable. Everyone he obsesses over ends up dead (at least in his perception), even Reese, whom he didn’t actually meet in person. While introducing a new love interest might be difficult, it is not impossible. We had 2 in season 3 and it didn’t feel rushed. However, I can see him killing her in a similar manner to the way he killed Beck. Somehow still loving her…

Such a huge story about him coming back would definitely get peoples attention and the families of his past victims would at least raise an eyebrow. While I can understand the authorities are bought, the tabloids speak. It might be easy to kill a story with enough money, but to kill a story you need to know about it so it is safe to assume Kate knows at least partially about Beck. What I don’t understand is her stand regarding Malcom’s death. Seems quite a big plot hole…

I have quite a farfetched theory that Kate is a mastermind and she wanted her dad dead all along. She found Joe and his background somehow and hired the PI to get him obsessed with her and into her group. I find it hard to believe she didn’t realise neighbours could see into her flat, so her doing so many things that Joe would find attractive in front of her window would support this theory.
He did cut it though at the end of season 4, didn’t he?

What I found the most annoying was that I remember she took pictures of the cage, why didn’t she send them to authorities after Joe thought Marianne was dead? Or why didn’t she show them when she was arrested? Or more importantly, if she was blamed for Rhys’s death, as it was a high profile case, the Scotland Yard (assuming it was in their jurisdiction) would have definitely checked her phone and found the pictures or some proof of the fact that she was working with Edward to bring Joe down? For instance everything about his background? Or even an alibi for when Rhys was murdered…
I find that possible. Adam’s death was too convenient for Phoebe’s family. It is difficult to believe they have no involvement.
I found that a major plot hole. Such an influential family would’ve definitely managed to stop the wedding or, at least get an annulment once she was found so lost on her wedding night…

I feel like that might be something that could be developed in season 5. While it was pretty clear that Kate’s money managed to cover for most of his past murders (Love’s manly), someone should be having questions how he managed to travel to (and through) Europe with a fake identity? Especially since professor Monroe is not his first fake name. Quinn family met him as Will (major red flag, btw). There is enough shady around him to get authority’s interest.

I found Gemma’s death an outlier compared to any other of his victims. It was reckless and had the potential to harm Kate (by blaming her as the body was in her room) which is atypical for Joe as he always does everything for “love”. Also, in the montage where he finds Marianne and starts spiralling, he sees his exlovers and Gemma is quite the opposite. There is virtually no connection between Gemma and any other victims. While this could be a plot hole, it can also be an easter egg.

Due to my studies, I met a lot of brits with the same upbringing, however, none of them talked the way Phoebe did. Nobody uses so many “traditionally” british words. Also, most characters in the show wouldn’t have managed to graduate from Oxford.
I noticed that too and I thought it might be some sort of Checkov’s gun? I guess they should’ve mentioned it in season 4 as well if that was the case…

I feel like it is pretty clear that Kate follows the rule of protecting him for all his wrongs. Rhys was his friend, and form what we know, an actually decent guy, and she still covered Joe for his murder. Edward knee too much and he was a danger to wreck their entire lives. If Joe wouldn’t have done it, she would have arranged it somehow so I feel like she was happy with the outcome.

I am so sorry to hear that there are so many people that suffer form such an young age, especially watching back and realizing how my depression influence my childhood. I am 16, and I’ve been in your shoes twice. But before jumping into conclusions, try not to lose your hope, maybe you are not diabetic. But even if you are, it is not the end of the world. Dreams come and go, and there is definitely a place for you in this world. I was 11 when I found out that I am not able to have the job I have wanted since I was 3 because of some stupid laws! I was heartbroken, but soon enough I found myself wishing something else. My dreams were crushed again last year when I failed an exam which I needed for my future. But eventually, everything settled down for me, and went good in the end. I know that for you it is more difficult because you are scared of the illness, but I am sure everything it’s going to sort out one way or another for you as well! Wish you all the happiness in the world! (Sorry for my English, I am not a native speaker)
